stack.doc: Lays children out in a column or a row.

alignment.doc: Cross-axis alignment. Default leading (vertical) or center (horizontal).

layers.doc: Stacks children on top of each other (first child at the back).

split.doc: Two panes side by side in landscape. In portrait they stack, or the second one hides.

ratio.doc: Share of the width for the first pane in landscape, 0.2 to 0.8. Default 0.58.

portraitHeight.doc: Height of the first pane when stacked in portrait.

scroll.doc: A scrolling container. Children are created lazily, so long feeds stay fast.

snap.doc: Settle on each child after a swipe (paging cards).

end.doc: Runs when the last child appears (load more).

footer.doc: Shown after the children, e.g. a spinner while more loads.

stick.doc: bottom keeps the newest (last) child in view as children arrive, like a chat. Default none.

grid.doc: A grid that fills rows with as many columns as fit.

minWidth.doc: Adaptive columns at least this wide (used when `columns` is not set). Default 140.

list.doc: A native grouped list, like iOS Settings. Put `section` and `row` components inside.

section.doc: A titled group. Inside a `list` it is a list section; elsewhere a rounded card.

card.doc: A flat rounded surface for content (posts, tiles).

inset.doc: Inner padding. Default 16. Use 0 for edge-to-edge media.

as.doc: Name for the current element in bindings. Default "item".

id.doc: Path inside each element that identifies it. Default "id".

empty.doc: Shown when there are no items.

pager.doc: Pages you swipe through one at a time, sideways or up and down. Vertical pagers resist past the first and last page. Use `bind` to read or move the page.

bind.doc: Screen variable holding the current page (from 0). Set it to change page.

indicator.doc: Page dots; auto fades them out after a moment. Default auto.

children.doc: One component per page; `each` works too.

label.doc: A symbol and text side by side.

slash.doc: Draw a diagonal slash through the symbol, for states SF Symbols has no slashed version of.

image.doc: A remote or packaged image. Animated GIFs play. Downloads are cached and downscaled.

src.doc: https URL, a path in your package such as "assets/logo.png", a data: URL, or a photo saved with the `photo` action.

placeholder.doc: Symbol shown when there is no image. Default "photo".

template.doc: Draw as a single-color glyph tinted with `foreground`.

tap.doc: Runs when the image is tapped, with where as `$value`: {"x": 0…1, "y": 0…1} from the top left. For remote screens.

gallery.doc: Swipe through images, with a page counter.

media.doc: Picks the right player: a video when there is one, a gallery for several images, otherwise an image. Handles spoilers and full-screen viewing.

inline.doc: Muted, looping, no controls: for feeds. Default false.

badge.doc: Small glass label in the bottom corner, e.g. "Video".

expandable.doc: Double-tap or pinch opens a full-screen viewer.

stat.doc: A labelled value with an optional progress bar.

progress.doc: A spinner, or a bar when `value` is set.

value.doc: 0 to 1. Leave out for a spinner.

gauge.doc: A circular gauge for a single reading.

text.doc: Text in the middle. Default the value.

chart.doc: A line, area or bar chart.

avatar.doc: A round picture, or initials when there is none.

ring.doc: Ring around the picture, e.g. green while someone speaks. Leave out (or null) for none.

dimmed.doc: Fade the picture, e.g. for someone muted.

row.doc: A list row: symbol or image, title, subtitle and a trailing value.

comment.doc: A threaded comment or chat message.

highlight.doc: Badge next to the author, e.g. "OP".

empty.doc: A centered message for empty, loading or error states.

lyrics.doc: Lines that follow a playing timeline, karaoke style: the current line is large, earlier ones fade. Tap a line to jump to it. Without times, the lines scroll as plain text.

timeline.doc: Name of a screen timeline (see Screen `timelines`). Default "main".

synced.doc: Follow the timeline. Default true when lines have times.

action.doc: Runs when a line is tapped, with its time as `$value`.

clock.doc: The current time, updated every second.

date.doc: Show the date under the time. Default true.

size.doc: Digit size in points. Default 112 (digital) or 84 (minimal); the analog dial is 220 wide.

web.doc: Escape hatch: an HTML page from your package (or an https site) inside the native screen. The page talks to your app through window.winmore.

props.doc: Sent to the page as winmore.props.

transparent.doc: Let the screen show through. Default true.

scroll.doc: Let the page scroll itself. Default true.

button.doc: A button. Use `glass` style for floating controls over content.

buttonShape.doc: Default capsule; circle for symbol-only buttons.

selected.doc: Highlights the button (tinted glass, filled symbol color).

confirm.doc: Ask this question before running the action.

symbolSize.doc: Symbol size in points. Default 17. Changing symbols (play and pause) animate.

loading.doc: Shows a spinner instead of the label.

pill.doc: A glass capsule that groups several symbol buttons with dividers.

children.doc: `button` components; their own glass is ignored.

menu.doc: A button that opens a menu.

buttonShape.doc: Default capsule, circle when there is no label.

chevron.doc: Show a small chevron after the label.

toggle.doc: An on/off switch. The new value is `$value` in the action.

slider.doc: A slider. The action runs when you let go, with the value as `$value`.

live.doc: Also run the action while dragging (at most about 8 times a second).

axis.doc: vertical draws a tall fader, like a mixer channel. Default horizontal.

scrubber.doc: A media position bar that keeps moving between updates from the PC. Drag to seek; a tap never jumps. Reads a screen timeline (see Screen `timelines`).

timeline.doc: Name of a screen timeline. Default "main".

times.doc: Show elapsed and remaining time. Default true.

action.doc: Runs when you let go, with the new position in seconds as `$value`.

stepper.doc: Minus and plus buttons around a value. The new value is `$value`.

picker.doc: Choose one option. The chosen value is `$value` in the action.

field.doc: A text field bound to a screen variable. It can type with the PC keyboard.

bind.doc: Screen variable that holds the text, e.g. "query" (read it as "$ui.query").

prefix.doc: Fixed text before the field, e.g. "r/".

submit.doc: Runs on Return, with the text as `$value`.

pcKeyboard.doc: Show the PC keyboard button. Default true.

clearable.doc: Show a clear button. Default true.

leading.doc: A control before the field, e.g. a scope menu.

link.doc: Opens a web page on the iPhone.

when.doc: Show the component only when this expression is truthy.

padding.doc: Inner spacing: a number for all sides, [vertical, horizontal], or [top, leading, bottom, trailing].

height.doc: Fixed height in points, or "screen" for the visible content height (minus `screenOffset`).

screenOffset.doc: Points subtracted from the screen height when `height` is "screen". Default 0.

maxWidth.doc: Maximum width; the component centers in wider space.

fill.doc: Grow to fill the available width, height or both.

align.doc: Where content sits inside the frame when it is larger than the content.

background.doc: Flat background color. Use `glass` for Liquid Glass instead.

glass.doc: Liquid Glass behind the component, in `shape`. Use it for floating controls only; content stays flat.

glassTint.doc: Tint for the glass, e.g. to mark a selected control.

shape.doc: Shape for `background`, `glass` and clipping. Default rounded.

corner.doc: Corner radius for the rounded shape. Default 24.

foreground.doc: Default color for text and symbols inside.

gradient.doc: Colors for a diagonal gradient background (top leading to bottom trailing), e.g. ["#0A84FFA6", "black"].

shadow.doc: Soft drop shadow with this radius, for artwork that floats.

scale.doc: Scale factor; changes animate, e.g. shrink artwork while paused.

action.doc: Runs when the component is tapped.

key.doc: Stable identity, so animations and state follow the right item.

title.doc: Shown in the app bar on PC and as the default navigation title.

chrome.doc: standard keeps WinMore's margins and music volume bar; fullscreen gives the app the whole content area. Default standard.

accent.doc: Selected and highlighted states. Default blue.

state.doc: Initial screen variables, read as "$ui.name" and changed with the `set` action.

let.doc: Named values worked out from data, e.g. {"unread": {"count": "$messages"}}; read them as "$unread". Sheets and covers can have their own `let`.

bar.doc: Floating glass bar: {leading:[…], trailing:[…]}. Use glass buttons, menus and pills.

accessory.doc: Shown under the bar, e.g. a search field.

sheets.doc: Named sheets: {name: {title, body, detents:["medium","large"]}}. Open with {"sheet":"name"}.

covers.doc: Named full-screen pages: {name: {bar, body, background}}. Open with {"cover":"name","params":…}.

refresh.doc: How often the phone asks for data: {interval: 1.5, fast: 0.45, fastWhen: "$loading"} in seconds.

timelines.doc: Media positions that keep moving between updates: {"main": {"track": "$song.id", "position": "$song.current", "duration": "$song.duration", "playing": "$song.playing"}} (seconds). `scrubber` and `lyrics` follow them.

persist.doc: Screen variables this iPhone remembers between launches, e.g. ["face", "theme"].

backdrop.doc: An image (usually album art) whose colors tint the whole screen background.

command.doc: Sends a command to your app on the PC: {"command":"open","value":…}. Optional "app" sends it to another app, "result":"name" stores the reply in a screen variable, and "onError" runs an action if it fails (the error message is $error).

cover.doc: Opens a named full-screen page; its bindings can read "$params": {"cover":"post","params":"$post"}.

dismiss.doc: Closes the sheet or page this action runs in: {"dismiss":true}.

open.doc: Opens a web page on the iPhone: {"open":"$post.url"}.

copy.doc: Copies text, or an image given as a data: URL or {"kind":"image","data":…}: {"copy":"$post.url"}.

paste.doc: Reads the iPhone clipboard into a screen variable as {"kind":"text"|"image","data":…} (images as a PNG data: URL under 2 MB), or null: {"paste":"clip"}. iOS asks once for permission.

photo.doc: Lets you choose a photo, keeps a copy on this iPhone and stores its path in a screen variable, for `image`: {"photo":"background","maxSize":1600}. Cancelling stops the list.

haptic.doc: Plays a haptic: light, medium, heavy, selection, success, warning, error.

refresh.doc: Asks the PC for fresh data now: {"refresh":true}.

OPERATORS.not: a — true when a is falsy
OPERATORS.count: a — length of a list or text
OPERATORS.in: [value, list] — list contains value (or text contains text)
OPERATORS.coalesce: [a, b, …] first value that is not null
OPERATORS.find: [list, path, value] — the first element whose path equals value, e.g. {"find": ["$members", "id", "$params"]}
OPERATORS.slice: [list, start, count] — part of a list
